entities.name: ord-0bf038f38919437a89668c77ed6d83a7
observations: Direct ORD match: activated heteroaromatic C–Cl is replaced by the secondary nitrogen of an N-trifluoroacetyl-protected diazabicyclic amine.
Recorded components include acetonitrile, HCl, and a DBN/DBU-like bicyclic amidine base; temperature, time, and isolated yield were not returned.

entities.name: Chloro fluoro quinolinone ester
observations: Reactant decodes to an ethyl chloro-fluoro tert-butyl quinolinone-3-carboxylate electrophile with an activated heteroaromatic C–Cl bond and retained aryl C–F bond.

entities.name: Protected diazabicyclic amine
observations: Reactant is O=C(N1C2CCC1CNC2)C(F)(F)F, an N-trifluoroacetyl-protected diazabicyclic amine containing a secondary ring nitrogen nucleophile.

entities.name: MeCN with DBN/DBU-like base
observations: Acetonitrile and a strong, non-nucleophilic bicyclic amidine base are recorded for the direct substitution; HCl is also recorded, likely from an amine salt or workup/formulation.

entities.name: ord-5697f74fd040474db14efb4422fa80ba
observations: Close SNAr analog: the same activated heteroaromatic chloride is displaced by piperazine.

entities.name: ord-2a7b0bbb4bd2498ba4d649e40f220154
observations: Close substitution analog: the same activated heteroaromatic chloride is displaced by an ethylthio group under basic conditions.
